review_type: 独立有限表复算；非G1执行器、非原典解释认证、非经验因果验证
method: 未导入validate_constructions.py，未读取模型hand_checks、calculations或expected用于求值。仅从状态、原始边、谓词外延、对象表、分区和显式V重新计算；review_requirement是审查者预期断言，computed由表运算生成。
independence_limit: 本代理曾起草CX09—CX12的候选卡；本轮对计算采取另写实现复核，不宣称独立人类审查。

checks.check: GenT(0) at all five states

checks.check: Alive at s2 does not enable gen
checks.calculation_basis: Check s2 membership and empty gen successor set separately.

checks.check: three safe positive ticks succeed but four fail
checks.calculation_basis: Filter each actual tick by both endpoint Alive values, then advance frontier.

checks.check: globally fresh births on the supplied chain
checks.calculation_basis: Keep accumulated Seen identities; do not merely compare adjacent extant rows.

checks.check: all displayed horizons respect prefix monotonicity
checks.calculation_basis: Direct evaluation for each state and T=0..6; the general result also follows by truncating witnesses.

checks.check: response endpoint
checks.calculation_basis: Sequential frontier traversal of stimulus then respond.

checks.check: feedback closed endpoint
checks.calculation_basis: Traverse all four named edge tables.

checks.check: removing feedback preserves response but destroys full episode
checks.calculation_basis: Only the feedback table is replaced by empty.

checks.check: norm evaluation includes nonempty precondition
checks.calculation_basis: Read complete expression records and the independently specified V table.

checks.check: exists approved successor but not all successors approved
checks.calculation_basis: Quantify over actual response successors, then consult He evaluation.

checks.check: deleting soft edge destroys approved reachability
checks.calculation_basis: Keep the same V and expression tables; retain only harsh response edge.

checks.check: exact execute-star reachable-goal set

checks.check: reconfiguration succeeds existentially but not universally
checks.calculation_basis: Compute all three reconfiguration destinations and intersect viable states.

checks.check: target has no positive continuation
checks.calculation_basis: Read tick edge table at done; star reflexivity does not count as a next step.

checks.check: split then merge at a
checks.calculation_basis: Traverse split choices and merge their successors.

checks.check: merge then split at b admits changed partition
checks.calculation_basis: Compute all branches, not only one witness.

checks.check: partitions are disjoint nonempty covers
checks.calculation_basis: Check nonempty blocks, no repeated member, and exact member set at every configuration.

checks.check: exact consistent naming states
checks.calculation_basis: Check each used symbol/object pair against the fixed denotation relation.

checks.check: repair reaches consistency but cannot recolor B
checks.calculation_basis: First compute repair targets; object color is a separately fixed predicate.

checks.check: dependency valid but base insufficient
checks.calculation_basis: Necessary condition is set inclusion in the indicated direction only.

checks.check: repair alone fails while repair-activate succeeds
checks.calculation_basis: Use the raw two distinct action tables.

checks.check: all configuration thresholds agree with explicit predicates
checks.calculation_basis: Compare all six numerical capacities to 3; terminal states are outside this classification domain.

checks.check: current A succeeds; stale A after reallocation fails
checks.calculation_basis: Directly propagate state frontiers using action tables.

checks.check: r33 has no weak channel
checks.calculation_basis: Read both capacities at 3 and evaluate the strict less-than threshold.

checks.check: two positive steps return yin
checks.calculation_basis: Two successor operations on the supplied flip relation.

checks.check: same classification with stationary relation cannot reach yang
checks.calculation_basis: Use countermodel raw edges and unchanged classification; any finite path remains yin.

checks.check: wet two-step maturation and dry impossibility
checks.calculation_basis: Apply no-command tests at both ends of local edges before graph traversal.

checks.check: stated Water implication is true at every supplied state
checks.calculation_basis: Evaluate antecedent and two-step consequent per state, including mature self-loop.

checks.check: guarded policy vs blanket let
checks.calculation_basis: Choose edges by Desire at the source; no decisions copied from normative table.

checks.check: permitted repair may still have a failed fact effect
checks.calculation_basis: Change only restore effect as specified; keeping V cannot change this endpoint.

checks.check: concept reciprocity does not imply populated cause table
checks.calculation_basis: Separate the two declared predicates, without auto-bridging.

checks.check: no direct reverse, five-step return
checks.calculation_basis: Compute one and five steps from the given ring.

checks.check: deleted resource edge blocks five-step return
checks.calculation_basis: Remove only the listed water-to-wood transition, then propagate five times.

current_R1.status: 模型定义；原文未给出此判定式

CX01_rule_wording_finding.explanation: A gen edge and live destination do not imply the source is Alive. Add the source Alive premise if R1 concludes GenT(1).

CX01_identity_boundary.reason: With fixed finite Entity and globally unique nonreused identities, each qualifying step consumes at least one previously unseen domain element. No infinite sequence of distinct fresh identities fits in the domain. Current extant differences alone do not establish global novelty after a return cycle.
CX01_identity_boundary.distinction: Finite states may support an infinite positive-time cycle, repeated events or reappearance of old IDs. That is different from infinitely many globally new unique identities.
